mapper.insert: insert into sql_optimization_result (sql_signature, original_sql, optimized_sql, suggestion, score, model_name, create_time, update_time) values (#{sqlSignature}, #{originalSql}, #{optimizedSql}, #{suggestion}, #{score}, #{modelName}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update sql_optimization_result set original_sql = #{originalSql}, optimized_sql = #{optimizedSql}, suggestion = #{suggestion}, score = #{score}, model_name = #{modelName}, update_time = #{updateTime} where sql_signature = #{sqlSignature}
